reasoning_content:
uv sync has been stuck on "Creating virtual environment" for a while — no wait, actually, the fact that it only shows "Creating virtual environment at: .venv" after the tail suggests that uv sync is slow (resolving/installing a large number of packages for a huge workspace of 40+ packages). Let me check whether the process is still running, and check the disk usage of .venv to see if it's in the middle of downloading.

Also, the docker pull of pgvector seems slow too. Let me directly check the docker pull progress and check the uv process.

action.command: ps aux | grep -E "uv sync|docker pull|pnpm" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13}' | head; echo "=== venv size ==="; du -sh /workspace/.venv 2>/dev/null; echo "=== uv log lines ==="; wc -l /tmp/uv-sync.log; tail -1 /tmp/uv-sync.log; echo "=== docker events ==="; docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}}" | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ps aux | grep -E \"uv sync|docker pull|pnpm\" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13}' | head; echo \"=== venv size ===\"; du -sh /workspace/.venv 2>/dev/null; echo \"=== uv log lines ===\"; wc -l /tmp/uv-sync.log; tail -1 /tmp/uv-sync.log; echo \"=== docker events ===\"; docker ps -a --format \"{{.Names}} {{.Status}}\" | head", "summary": "Check whether background processes are alive"}

summary: Check whether background processes are alive
